description: This file defines a service class 'TextHelperService' providing string utility methods such as length checking, containment, starting and ending with checks, with compatibility fallbacks for older PHP versions.

classes.name: TextHelperService
classes.description: Provides utility string methods with support for both modern and legacy PHP functions.

methods.name: strLength
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, using mb_strlen if available, otherwise strlen.

methods.name: strContains
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a given substring, using str_contains if available, otherwise fallback.

methods.name: strStartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given substring, using str_starts_with if available, otherwise fallback.

methods.name: strEndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given substring, using str_ends_with if available, otherwise fallback.
